# Recording frames

## The frame card

Every frame gets a number burned into its top bar. The card lists the number, the date of the inspection, and a short note on brood, honey or pollen. Table 1 sets out the columns most keepers use.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Frame | Number burned into the top bar |
| Drawn | Month the comb was first drawn |
| Contents | Brood, honey, pollen or empty |

## Retiring comb

Comb older than three seasons is cut out and rendered for wax. Fig. 2 shows how the colour of comb darkens with age, from pale yellow in its first season to deep brown by its third.
